calibration_method: date-balanced, lead-time-relevance-weighted Platt scaling per model and ensemble

prediction_correlation_final_holdout.conclusion: Models show mixed prediction similarity; ensemble benefit must be judged together with holdout PR-AUC, Lift@50 and calibration.

limitations: The label has no fixed horizon; unresolved paths are right-censored and excluded rather than forced negative.
A temporary drawdown does not force a negative label; only a persistent confirmed structural breakdown ends the current setup episode.
Very late positives remain positive but receive a documented smooth relevance discount, so reported probability is relevance-weighted toward detectable precursor states.
Corporate-action policy should preferably be adjusted; large recent jumps are quarantined point-in-time.
Fundamental/news/ownership data are not included in this OHLCV technical model.
Probability calibration must be rechecked after market-regime changes.
Top-50 outcome backtest is a ranking audit, not executable portfolio PnL.

portfolio_ranking_comparison.important_note: When market-cap coverage is insufficient, portfolio_bucket uses a point-in-time traded-value proxy and market_cap_bucket is UNAVAILABLE.

entry_quality_note: entry_quality is an interpretable 0-100 timing score, not a calibrated probability; wave probability and entry timing are intentionally reported separately.
second_stage_ranking_note: wave_probability is the calibrated 0-100 model probability. accumulation_score, trend_quality_score, liquidity_score, and final_score are interpretable ranking scores, not calibrated probabilities. Label generation, model fitting, features, and probability calibration are unchanged by this layer.
